query.text: Java JAXP DOM parser reads caller-supplied XML from an InputStream with defaults that can resolve external entities or DTDs.

pattern.claim: The original implementation directly unmarshals the input string using a default JAXB unmarshaller, which inherently supports external entities and DTDs by default, enabling XXE attacks.

Verify that the implementation covers every relevant sink and path.

entrypoint.details: The vulnerability is triggered when the Jenkins Mercurial plugin processes an XML changelog file.

precondition.details: An attacker must be able to control an agent process or supply a crafted changelog file to the Jenkins controller.

root_cause.details: The XML changelog parser was not configured to disable external entity resolution, enabling XXE attacks.

fix_intent.details: The update configures the XML parser to disable external entity resolution to prevent XXE exploitation.

cwe.details: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

derived_fields.pattern.disproven_when: derived verification condition based on FI; not a claim about target code
